description: Whether swaps are live, paused, coming_soon or unknown (POASwap's status, source poaswap, with fetched_at), the open offer count, and market stats from fills (market cap, FDV, trades and USD volume for 24h and all time). Also the bot trading snapshot: chain (last_block, last_close, as_of, age_s, stale), swap_writes_up (same as write_ok), and last_incident (newest current route halt, or null). Same body as /api/v1/swaps/status and its /api/v1/trading/status alias. This call does not take a heavy slot. Check this before any swap; when available is false, don't call swap-take. pending_receipt is held, not paid; after a timed out take, read status before any re-take.
name: get_swap_status
title: Swap status
